minecraft:suspicious_gravel: Breaking it normally (even with Silk Touch) or brushing it destroys the block to reveal its hidden loot instead of dropping itself. To get the block itself (empty, no loot), let it fall as a falling-block entity for about 30 seconds without landing - drop it into a 2-block-deep upward soul sand bubble column, or onto two stacked cobwebs, and it lands as a pickupable item.
minecraft:suspicious_sand: Breaking it normally (even with Silk Touch) or brushing it destroys the block to reveal its hidden loot instead of dropping itself. To get the block itself (empty, no loot), let it fall as a falling-block entity for about 30 seconds without landing - drop it into a 2-block-deep upward soul sand bubble column, or onto two stacked cobwebs, and it lands as a pickupable item.
